solve.light: T-2848, read off the photograph: overcast winter light (snow lies in the gutters). Both the Prairie front and the 18th Street flank read flat and dark, and the lamp standards, poles and hydrant throw nothing on the pavement, so no sun direction can be read. The render uses the overcast sky and no sun_uvy.
